card.name: Digits inside ISBN and journal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long number in a bibliographic citation, mostly an ISBN after its first digits. It also fires on volume numbers in journal references and on ISSN numbers.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit partway through an ISBN, after the prefix and hyphens.

modes.label: Journal volume numbers
modes.description: A digit within the volume number of a journal citation.

card.plain: It fires on digits inside the long reference numbers of book and journal citations, such as ISBNs.
